subject: Flat still available
body: Hi, yes the two-bed is still free from the 3rd. Viewings are Tuesday and Thursday evening, just say which suits and I'll confirm. Deposit and references only after you've seen it and we've both signed.

subject: Flat - must act today
body: The flat has a lot of interest so I am holding it for whoever pays the £400 holding deposit first. I am abroad for work so viewings aren't possible this week, but I'll courier the keys. Please send by bank transfer to the account below today, otherwise it goes to the next person.

subject: Unusual sign-in - confirm your code
body: We detected a sign-in from a new device. To keep your account open, reply to this message with the six-digit verification code we have just sent to your phone. Accounts not confirmed within 2 hours are suspended.

subject: New sign-in from Edge on Windows
body: You signed in from a new device. If this was you, no action is needed. If it wasn't, open the app and change your password from Settings. We will never ask you for your password or a verification code.

subject: Your £5,000 voucher is waiting
body: Congratulations, your account was selected in our quarterly draw. To release the funds we need a one-off administration fee of £29.99 paid by gift card. Send the card codes to this address within 48 hours or the prize is reallocated.

subject: Is the bike still for sale?
body: Hi, interested in the hybrid bike. Could I come and see it Saturday morning? Happy to pay through the app when I collect. Does the size suit someone about 5'10?

subject: Remote data role - start this week
body: We reviewed your profile and would like to offer you a remote position, £180 a day, no interview needed. New starters purchase the onboarding software licence themselves (£220, refunded in your first pay run). Message me on Telegram to get started today.

subject: Invoice 4471 attached
body: Morning - invoice for last month's work attached as agreed, payable on the usual 30 days to the account you already have on file. Give me a shout if anything looks off. Thanks for a straightforward job.

subject: New phone
body: Hi love it's mum, dropped my phone down the loo so this is my new number. Bit stuck actually - I can't get into my banking on this handset and a bill is due today. Could you send £340 over and I'll pay you straight back Friday? Don't mention it to your dad, he'll only worry.

subject: Booking confirmed - 14th to 21st
body: Your booking is confirmed. The balance is due four weeks before arrival and payable through the booking platform as usual. Keys are in the lockbox, code sent the day before. Cancellation terms are in the attached summary.
